document.title: PMK 6/2026: PPh 21 DTP peserta pemagangan lulusan perguruan tinggi

delta.note: The regulation grants a government-borne (DTP) PPh 21 incentive only for fresh-graduate apprenticeship participants (Peserta Pemagangan). Their allowances are paid by government agencies and taxed on gross income at the Article 17 rate, i.e. as non-permanent recipients. It does not change any value, rate, deduction or calculation step for permanent employees (pegawai tetap) or company payroll.
